system.powers: All Ebon Dragon Charms (see The Manual of Exalted Power: The Infernals, Chapter Five, and Return of the Scarlet Empress pp. 207-212). Adapted Charms from Adorjan, Cecelyne, Malfeas, and SWLIHN. All sorcery and necromancy of all circles permitted by his initiation Charms.
system.notes:
Strike: Speed 5, Accuracy 20, Damage 10B/L, Rate 5 (via Ebon Dragon Glory Incarnate)

Blast: Speed 5, Accuracy 20, Damage 10B/L, Range 1 mile, Rate 5

Greater Imperfection of Ultimate Darkness: defensive Charms cost additional motes equal to channeled Virtue. Channeling any Virtue to defend against his attacks causes the defense to perfectly succeed.

Each attack against him cannot inflict more damage levels than the attacker's Essence or artifact weapon's rating (whichever higher).
system.biography:
The Shadow of All Things. The mastermind behind the Reclamation, architect of the Empress's return, darkest of all the Yozis, sworn nemesis of all things. His body can take any shape of tangible darkness from 1 to 100 yards in any dimension (once he has Ebon Dragon Worldshaper Assumption). All attributes are 0; he acts through Ebon Dragon Glory Incarnate which applies a pool of 20 to any enhanceable action.

Source: Return of the Scarlet Empress.
